重要訊息

聯發科將於 10 月 30 日召開法說會並公布 3Q26 財報。

評論及分析

3Q26 營運表現可望優於市場共識及公司財測。聯發科 3Q26 營收 1,680 億元，季增 10.4%，較公司財測上緣高出 5%，亦較我們預估及市場共識高出 5-8%。我們認為營收優於預期主要受惠於旗艦手機 SoC 天璣 9600 提前拉貨，以及通訊晶片需求維持強勁。隨著營運槓桿改善，我們預估 3Q26 營益率將較 2Q26 的 15% 提升 1.4ppts 至 16.4%。

4Q26 營收成長可能略低於先前預期。展望 4Q26，我們預期公司將提出營收強勁季增的財測，惟 AI ASIC 專案量產爬坡將使利潤率小幅下滑。我們預估 4Q26 營收季增 34%，低於先前預估的 48%，主要考量：(1) 3Q26 比較基期墊高；(2) 4Q26 智慧型手機需求轉弱；以及 (3) Zebrafish 於 4Q26 的量產爬坡速度略低於預期。聯發科於上次法說會曾預估 2026 年 ASIC 營收目標由 20 億美元上修至超過 20 億美元，惟考量量產端的不確定性，我們預估 2026 年 AI ASIC 營收將低於 20 億美元。

Humufish 量產面臨瓶頸，惟 2028 年 Zebrafish 出貨量有上修空間。我們先前報告指出，由於 IC 製成供應短缺及生產良率存在不確定性，Humufish 於 Intel EMIB-T 產線的量產爬坡時程已由 4Q27 延後至 2Q28，因此我們認為市場對 Humufish 可能於 1Q27 重新流片的疑慮過度。然而，根據相關供應鏈查核，考量籌組短短設計修改及邀請修訂的時程延宕，我們將 2028 年 Humufish 出貨量預估由 330 萬顆下修至 200 萬顆。另一方面，目前並未觀察到 TPU 需求放緩的跡象，因此我們將 2028 年 Zebrafish 出貨量預估由 80 萬顆上修至 150 萬顆。考量整體出貨量預估較去年衰退 8-10%，且 Zebrafish 的 ASP 遠低於 Humufish，我們將聯發科 2028 年 AI ASIC 營收預估下修 28%，由 500 億美元降至 360 億美元，仍年增 139%。

投資建議

我們維持以 25 年景氣循環高峰本益比 25 倍作為目標價評價基準，惟因下修獲利預估，將目標價下調至 5,500 元。考量 TPU 需求強勁成長，以及聯發科在 AI ASIC 市場的市占率持續提升，聯發科仍為我們半導體產業首選標的之一，維持「增加持股」評等。

投資風險

智慧型手機出貨衰退；AI 晶片進展放緩。

 research indicates severe packaging constraints and price hikes among leading analog
 players. Meanwhile, LEAP demand across GPUs, CPUs and ASICs continues to accelerate,
 supported by AMD's full-process packaging business, pricing gains and slower-than-expected
 competitor capacity expansion. We expect LEAP's ATM revenue contribution to rise from 23%
 in 2026 to 32% in 2027, driving margin expansion despite higher capex. Factoring in stronger
 ASPs, LEAP growth and our earnings preview, we raise 2026E/2027E EPS by 6%/12% and
 lift our TP from NT$754 to NT$843, based on 25x 2027E EPS.

 Packaging supply tightness broadens: Our supply chain research suggests that packaging
 has emerged as a critical bottleneck, extending beyond AI GPUs into mature-node
 applications, including analog, with lead times lengthening by >30% and unfilled orders rising.
 Advanced packaging and testing pricing should also remain aggressive, driven by AI demand
 and longer testing times. According to an Oct 13 EDN report, OSAT prices have risen 10–30%
 amid tightening supply, reinforcing our expectations of 10–80% price hikes for
 FC/Wirebond/QFN and 10–20% for CoWoS in 3Q26–4Q26.

 LEAP on AMD’s higher wafer allocation, limited competition, etc: We believe AMD's
 server CPU roadmap to accelerate, by full adoption of CoWoS for Venice and beyond including
 the recently announced Verano. Additionally, our supply chain research suggests increased
 wafer supply for AMD’s CPU in 2Q-4Q27, due to Intel’s shift from TSMC’s 2nm to its own 18A.
 Additionally, we believe another OSAT CoWoS supplier’s expansion is slower than expected,
 likely the U.S. expansion in 2028. Together with increasing demand from TSMC for CP and
 oS, we forecast its LEAP to be $4bn/$8bn in 2026E/2027E, vs. guidance of $3.6bn/$7.2bn.

 Earnings preview: 3Q26 sales rose 28% QoQ on IC ATM of +20% QoQ and EMS of +42%
 QoQ. We expect GM to be at the high end of guidance and EPS of $5.3 in 3Q26. For 4Q26,
 we expect IC ATM sales to be +9% QoQ and EMS to be -5% QoQ; with price hikes and higher
 mix of LEAP, we expect GM to be 23% in 4Q26.

 Risks: 1) AI slowdown; 2) consumer demand; 3) peer competition; 4) capacity delay.

                                                    Valuation and Recommendation

                                                    Maintain Buy with TP of NT$843

                                                    We rate ASE (3711 TT) Buy and set our TP at NT$843 which is based on 25x our 2027E EPS. We
                                                    adopt 2027 as valuation basis to capture its robust LEAP business potential which is the key market
                                                    focus and is expected to see aggressive capacity expansion. We adopt P/E methodology as we believe
                                                    the market now mainly focuses on the company’s earnings outlook.

                                                    The ASE/SPIL is the highest-quality OSAT and NO.1 in market share worldwide, backed by superior
                                                    operational management, M&As, economies of scale, and customer/product diversification. We like
                                                    ASE as we view it as an AI beneficiary with increasing margin-accretive AI/LEAP business in 2026 and
                                                    beyond. We believe the business will be driven by oS and CP in 2026, with emerging driver of full
                                                    process business ramping in 2H26.

                                                    ASE’s P/E traded at an average of 14x since 2021 but was up to an average of 19x since 1Q24 when
                                                    the company meaningfully started AI business. We derive our target price based on 25x P/E, which is
                                                    meaningfully higher than the mid-cycle level given its fast-growing AI momentum.

禾伸堂 3026 TT（電子零組件）

AI 電源升級．高階 MLCC 放量

投資與評價

1. 預期禾伸堂 3Q26 受惠 GPU 及 TPU/ASIC 平台拉貨，營運動能可望維持；4Q26 隨著設備供應商應能配合出貨持續增加，獲利將再創新高。
2. 禾伸堂 26、27 年 MLCC 產能分別年增約 30%、40%，稼動率接近滿載，客戶 27 年需求多為倍數成長，自製 MLCC 毛利率約 40 至 45%，產品組合轉變將持續推升毛利率，預估 26 年 EPS 15.99 元、27 年 EPS 35.43 元。
3. 目前禾伸堂股價 735 元，約為 20.7X FY27E EPS。為歷史本益比參考區間 11 至 65 倍之中下緣。高階譜振電容驗證門檻高、客戶轉換意願低，供貨地位穩固。Class 2 輸出電容亦將於 27 年成為第二成長引擎，考量市場尚未反映 27 年漲價及產能之增長威力，以參考本益比區間中間值下之 25 倍作為評價基礎，給予買進投資評等，目標價 900 元（25x FY27E PER）。

重點更新

禾伸堂 3Q26 受惠 ASIC 需求放量，營收季增 10.8%

禾伸堂 3Q26 營收 45.39 億元（+10.8% QoQ），其中 9 月營收 15.98 億元。目前 MLCC 稼動率接近滿載，新客戶交期已拉長至約 20 週。GPU 平台電源與 BBU 對高壓 NP0 諧振電容需求維持強勁，出貨主力為 Blackwell 平台；TPU/ASIC 平台需求 9 月起明顯放大，帶動 X7R 100V 輸出電容拉貨；第三季新建設備仍在調機，成長主要來自既有設備良率與單位時間產出提升。受惠高階 MLCC 占比提升，預估毛利率季增 2.6 個百分點至 28.8%，營業利益季增 32.4% 至 8.30 億元，稅後淨利 6.94 億元（+8.1% QoQ）、EPS 4.18 元，毛利率連續三季提升。

預期禾伸堂 4Q26 新設備貢獻產能，毛利率突破三成

預期禾伸堂 3Q26 進廠設備完成調機後於 4Q26 開始貢獻產能。高階 MLCC 產出持續增加。GB 系列在 1Q27 前仍為最大宗，Vera Rubin 放量後兩者將並行成長，TPU/ASIC 平台則將有完整一季貢獻；代理線及系統模組持平。營收結構將逐步走向 MLCC 貢獻，預估 4Q26 營收 48.72 億元（+7.3% QoQ）、毛利率季增 2.4 個百分點至 31.2%，營業利益季增 21.2% 至 10.06 億元，稅後淨利 8.42 億元（+21.3% QoQ）、EPS 5.08 元，營益率站上 20%，營運動能強勁。

                                                                      Wiwynn
                                                                      Company description
                                                                      Established in April 2012 and listed in March 2019, Wiwynn is one of the
                                                                      leading cloud infrastructure providers focusing on servers, storage, and rack
                                                                      solutions for global CSPs' data centers. Key customers include Microsoft,
                                                                      Meta Platforms, and Amazon, which together accounted for >90% of sales
                                                                      with tier-2 CSPs accounting for single-digit percentage of sales. Wiwynn
                                                                      used to be running at an asset-light business model but has expanded
                                                                      capacity for server motherboard manufacturing and rack final assembly on its
                                                                      own in recent years, increasing in-house supply ratio.

                                                                      Investment strategy
                                                                      We rate Wiwynn as Buy. We expect the secular growth in global data center
                                                                      and cloud-based IP traffic to act as a key driver for Wiwynn in years to come.
                                                                      We expect Wiwynn to benefit from data center growth amid rising ODM
                                                                      Direct/white-box server adoption. With order momentum having started to
                                                                      recover since 4Q23, we see Wiwynn's growth being backed by continuous
                                                                      rollouts of data centers from existing customers and new project wins from
                                                                      Amazon.

                                                                      Valuation
                                                                      Our target price for Wiwynn is NT$3,200. We value Wiwynn based on PE as
                                                                      we believe the company’s earnings performance and industry dynamics will
                                                                      be the key focus areas for the market. Our TP is based on 16x 2027E EPS,
                                                                      which is at the top end of the historical trading range since listing and above
                                                                      the average PE multiple of the peer group. We believe our target multiple is
                                                                      justified by the company’s 100% exposure to data centers, rising scale, and
                                                                      robust earnings growth, as well as stabilizing ROE.

                                                                      Risks
                                                                      Key downside risks that could cause Wiwynn’s shares to trade below our
                                                                      target price include: 1) Potential volatility in capex deployment; 2) Component
                                                                      price hike; 3) Peer competition; and 4) FX volatility.

       公司簡介：大量成立於 1980 年，總部位於桃園八德， 2013 年於台灣證交所
       上市，生產基地位於台灣八德及中國江蘇南京、漣水。公司主要產品為 PCB
       鑽孔機、成型機與厚度量測機 (TM)。以 2025 年營收結構來看，高階 CCD 機
       種占比約 46%，標準機種約 42%，半導體設備約 7%，玻璃邊緣塗佈機約 5%；
       銷售地區以中國為主，占 68.7%，其次為東南亞 21.7%、台灣 9.6%。公司自
       行開發控制器與軟體，是±2mil 背鑽量測解決方案的唯一供應商；半導體事
       業已於 2026 年 8 月 1 日分拆為大量先進智能。 2025 年員工數約 618 人。

       圖表一、大量營收產品組合趨勢


       資料來源：Bloomberg、中信投顧彙整


       板廠客戶資本支出上修，鑽孔設備直接受惠：大量的客戶以台系 PCB 板廠為
       主，包含欣興(3037)、臻鼎-KY(4958)、金像電(2368)等大型板廠。受惠 AI 伺
       服 器 需 求 強 勁 ， 主 要 客 戶 持 續 加 碼 資 本 支 出 ， 三 家 合 計 2Q26 資 本 支 出 達
       245.5 億元，季增 27.1%、年增 51.7%（見圖表二），近四季累計 785.4 億元，
       年增 43.6%。展望 2026 年，根據台灣電路板協會 (TPCA)資料，全年 PCB 相
       關資本支出規模將達 2,300 億元。其中欣興、臻鼎、金像電的 2026 年資本支
       出分別為 540 億元、逾 800 億元及 190 億元，較年初規劃的 254 億元、逾
       500 億元及 170 億元均大幅上修，三家合計逾 1,530 億元，占產業資本支出
       逾 6 成，且皆於指出 2027 年資本支出仍將維持高檔。鑽孔設備是板廠擴產
       的必要投資，且 AI PCB 的單片鑽孔時間持續拉長，我們預期大量將直接受
       惠於主要客戶的擴產循環。
       圖表二、主要客戶資本支出趨勢 (欣興、臻鼎、金像電 ), 單位:百萬台幣


       資料來源：中信投顧整理


                       2
 個股報告
                                              2026/10/19

       大量的鑽孔設備需求主要來自兩段製程： (1)一鑽通孔段，這是 PCB 製程的
       必要工序，鑽孔方式分雷射鑽孔與機械鑽孔，大量供應機械鑽孔設備；(2)背
       鑽，隨 AI 伺服器的高速傳輸需求提升，背鑽已成高階 PCB 的關鍵製程。
       (1)一鑽通孔段：多層板壓合後，各層線路被絕緣介電層隔開，需要用機械鑽
       針貫穿板材形成通孔(PTH)，再經鍍銅讓各層導通。AI PCB 朝高層數 HLC 與
       高階 HDI 混壓的方向發展，HLC 核心層由過去的 20~24 層提升到 40 層以上
       (見圖表三 )。層數 增加 使板厚上升，單片 板須 分段鑽孔，可疊板 加工 的片數
       也減少；加上高階 CCL 材料較硬，鑽針耗損加快、加工速度下降，單位鑽孔
       時間因此明顯拉長。同時，每櫃 PCB 的面積與孔數持續增加，在孔數增加×
       單孔時間拉長的效果下，板廠對機械鑽孔的產能需求將倍數成長，將帶動大
       量鑽孔機需求成長。
       圖表三、主流 AI GPU/ASIC 不同世代 PCB 規格


       資料來源：中信投顧整理


       圖表四、PCB 通孔示意圖


       資料來源：WDF


                   3
 個股報告
                                                  2026/10/19

       (2)背鑽 (Backdrill)：PCB 完成通孔並鍍銅後，整支孔都會導電，但訊號不一
       定要連通每一層。例如訊號只需要從第 1 層走到第 8 層，孔銅卻一路延伸到
       第 30 層，第 8 層以下這段沒用到的孔銅稱為 Stub(殘銅)。Stub 在高頻傳輸
       下會造成訊號反射與共振，使訊號損耗增加；Stub 越長，影響越明顯。傳輸
       速率由 112G 提升到 224G 以後，可容忍的 Stub 長度持續縮短，因此需要從
       板子背面把多餘的孔銅鑽除，也就是背鑽。背鑽必須對準既有通孔，並把鑽
       孔深度控制在目標層附近，鑽太深會切斷訊號、鑽太淺則殘留過長，精度要
       求明顯高於一鑽通孔段，因此主要採用具影像對位功能的 CCD 鑽孔機。隨
       AI 伺服器傳輸速率持續提升，背鑽滲透率與精度要求同步提高，等於在一鑽
       之外多出一道高精度鑽孔工序，將帶動大量 CCD 背鑽機的需求。

       圖表五、背鑽概念示意圖


       資料來源：iPCB

       Rubin 背鑽精度要求提升，TM4 為 Z 軸深度控制的關鍵方案：背鑽精度主
       要看兩項指標。(1)對位度：背鑽孔要對準原本的通孔，目前業界要求背鑽孔
       徑在原孔徑加 6 mil(D+6 mil)以內，目前終端客戶尚未要求縮小到 D+4 mil，
       短期不是主要瓶頸。(2)殘銅(Stub)長度：這是 影 響訊號品質的關鍵，客 戶要
       求也最嚴格。以 NVIDIA 為例，PCB 訊號頻率由 Blackwell 世代的 28GHz 提
       升到 Rubin 世代的 56GHz，背鑽殘銅精度要求也隨之由 ±3 mil 收斂到±2 mil，
       以避免殘銅干擾訊號（見圖表六）。

       圖表六、NVIDIA GPU 平台背鑽殘銅精度要求


       資料來源：中信投顧整理


       殘銅長度取決於背鑽在 Z 軸（深度）的控制精度：AI PCB 面積擴大後，壓
       合產生的翹曲(Warpage)會讓板內各孔位的實際深度不同，而單片大板的孔數
       動輒上萬，若用固定深度背鑽，很難把殘銅控制在±2 mil 以內。大量的厚度
       量測儀(Thickness Metrology, TM)在背鑽前先量測各孔內層銅層的實際深度，
       再把深度資料傳給背鑽機逐孔調整，讓殘銅控制在規格內。TM 採用公司自
       行開發的控制器與軟體，只能搭配自家的高階 CCD 背鑽機使用，並且現在
       主要競爭同業大族、Schmoll 並沒有相對應 TM 的 Z 軸量測解決方案，故我
       們認爲背鑽在 PCB 製程的滲透率逐步提升下，大量將會在鑽孔機市場持續

       CCD 機種滲透率提升，產品組合轉向高階：CCD 機種是在鑽孔機與成型機
       上加裝影像對位系統（Charge-Coupled Device, CCD）。加工前先用鏡頭辨識
       板面上的對位標記，依線路的實際位置修正 XY 軸（平面）的加工座標，CCD
       機種單價約為標準機台的 2~3 倍。大量的 CCD 機種分為 CCD 成型機與 CCD
       鑽孔機，其中成型與鑽孔約各占一半。

       (1)CCD 成型機：成型是 PCB 製程在測試前的最後階段，負責把整片大板依
       設計外形切割成單片電路板。一般 PCB 的公差標準較寬鬆，用標準成型機即
       可。光模塊 PCB 的尺寸小，焊墊(Bonding Pad)到板邊的距離必須精準控制。
       800G 光模塊的精度要求在 50µm 以內，1.6T 進一步縮小到 25µm 以內，需要
       用 CCD 成型機依線路實際位置修正切割路徑。隨 800G 光模塊進入量產、
       1.6T 預計 2027 年量產，預計 CCD 成型機的出貨動能將不輸鑽孔機。大量在
       CCD 成型機市場的市占 40%以上，光模塊成型機更高， 為市場領導者。

       (2)CCD 鑽孔機：背鑽要對準原本的通孔，因此必須使用 CCD 鑽孔機。分工
       上，CCD 負責 XY 軸對位，TM 負責量測各孔的 Z 軸實際深度，背鑽機再依
       TM 的深度資料逐孔控深加工。目前每台 TM4 約帶動 5~6 台 CCD 鑽孔機的
       需求。至於一鑽通孔段，過去多使用標準機台；但隨 SerDes 速率由 112G 提
       升到 224G，PCB 佈線密度提高，線寬線距與焊墊 (Pad)同步縮小，孔環寬度
       縮減，通孔段可容忍的鑽偏程度跟著降低，一鑽的 XY 對位精度要求也開始
       比照背鑽。公司簡報也已將高階 PCB 的通孔鑽孔列為 CCD 鑽孔機的獨立應
       用，目前已有客戶在一鑽階段導入。加上高階 AI PCB 單片價值高、鑽孔不
       良的報廢成本大，我們預期一鑽導入 CCD 將成為明確趨勢，CCD 鑽孔機的
       應用將由背鑽延伸到一鑽。

       綜合上述，我們預期 CCD 機種滲透率將持續提升。 CCD 機種的單價與毛利
       率 均 明 顯 高 於 標 準 機 台 ： 標 準 機 台 毛 利 率 約 15~20%， 高 階 CCD 機 種 約
       45~60%。我們預估高階機種（含 TM）的出貨占比將由公司 2026 年目標的
       60%，進一步提升到 2027 年的 70%，帶動毛利率由 1H26 的 43.5%提升至
       2027 年的 55.9%(見圖表九)。

緯穎 6669 TT(電子-電腦及週邊設備)
GPU、ASIC 並進，27 年獲利創高

買進－維持買進
目標價：2,400 元　+30.1%
收盤價：1,845 元

投資與評價

1. 因缺料影響降低，加上 Trainium3 開始出貨，緯穎 3Q26 營收優於預期17%，上修獲利25%至 EPS 43.9元，3Q26 營收、獲利將同創新高。

2. 在 ASIC、GPU 貢獻下，4Q26 營收估季增高個位數，AI 比重將逾55~60%，因 2H26 優於預期，上修今年營收8%至1.46兆元、EPS 140.3元。

3. AMD Helios 為緯穎27年強勁動能，加上公司為 Trainium2 水冷產品主要供應，帶動27年稅後獲利 YoY +60%，CB 股權稀釋權1.03%，EPS 估續創新高達224.71元，維持買進評等，目標價2,400元。

重點更新

3Q26 營收、獲利上修，反映一般伺服器位數增及液冷 ASIC 加入貢獻

緯穎 3Q26 營收4,346億元，QoQ+56%、YoY+63%，優於研究部預期17%，主要因缺料影響較預期低，加上9月 AWS Trainium3 開始出貨，因本季一般伺服器占比超越50%，估毛利率維持8.53%，稅後獲利上修25%至245.95億元、YoY+59%至 EPS 43.9元，預期3Q26 營收、獲利將同創新高。

4Q26 AI 比重將升至55%以上，ASIC、GPU 同步貢獻，上修今年營收8%

研究部估緯穎 4Q26 營收將季增高個位數，AI 部分，ASIC 出貨 Trainium3 液冷貢獻，ASP 估較氣冷版翻倍成長；此外，GPU 部分，預期 AMD Helios 及 Oracle Vera Rubin 皆有少量出貨，加上缺料持續改善，估 AI 比重將超越55~60%，毛利率下滑至8.2%，稅後獲利 YoY+81%、EPS 44.5元。因2H26 狀況優於預期，上修今年營收8%至1.46兆元 YoY+54%，反映下半年 AI 比重將升至55%，毛利率8.38%，稅後獲利 YoY+54%、EPS 140.34元。

27年營運在 ASIC、GPU 成長增速下，獲利將再創新高

展望2027年，預期 AMD Helios 將為 AI 強勁動能，2027年 AMD GPU 機櫃估達到六千櫃、ASP 500萬美元，加上 VR 機櫃貢獻，估使 GPU 占比拉升至30%。ASIC 部分，我們認為緯穎仍是 Trainium 水冷產品主供，預期 AWS 水冷比重大幅攀升，估 AWS 營收年增四到五成，一般伺服器維持兩成以上增長。綜上，上修27年營收11%至2.64兆元、YoY+80.4%，因 AI 占比持續提升達成，估毛利率下滑至7.35%，稅後獲利 YoY+60%、EPS 224.71元，維持續創新高。籌資部分，緯穎將於11月完成150億元國內可轉債發行，預計在1Q27~2Q27分別使用80億元、70.75億元，對於整體股權稀釋權1.03%，影響有限。

ICA/IPO: Gaining traction, but cost still a hurdle. A China CSP outlined optical
form factors from XPO/NPO to interposer optics (IPO) and CPO, including
integration of IPO with interposer copper attach (ICA). TE Connectivity showcased
224G/448G NPO/CPO sockets and ICA sockets with 0.4mm pitch and up to 10,000
pins, offering high-density connectivity, low crosstalk and improved reworkability.
We see rising traction for ICA/IPO, with potential mass production in 2027 (For
more, see our recent CPO report).

Marvell IMC: Complementary to AST2700, not a replacement. Marvell
demonstrated the OCTEON-based infrastructure management controller (IMC)
addresses higher-level Al rack/cluster telemetry and control; ASPEED's AST2700
BMC continues to handle node-level security and remote management. Given
distinct functions and software ecosystems, we do not view IMC as a direct
AST2700 competitor. We also don't see an AST2700 production issue, supporting
an on-track ramp. The key debate is actually market share in TPU/Axion.

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

                        making up c.50% of 3Q sales on our estimate, while OPM recovered to 10.7%,
                        +4.2ppt q/q and +1.3ppt y/y. Nevertheless, the sales shortfall constrained op
                        leverage, leaving margin improvement insufficient to offset weaker sales.

                        PSU vendor shortages weigh on Oct; 12kW ramp to drive Nov sales rebound —
                        Our industry checks suggest that Dynapack's major PSU vendor has encountered
                        component supply shortages (related to power management IC) and therefore
                        delayed BBU pull-ins, weighing on shipments of Dynapack's existing 3kW and 5kW
                        BBU products in Oct. We therefore expect Oct-26 BBU sales to decline slightly m/m.
                        Meanwhile, PC sales should recover sequentially and more than to offset the BBU
                        softness, supporting a slight m/m increase in group sales. Looking beyond Oct-26,

                        Dynapack International
                        Valuation
                        We assign a 32x target P/E to our 2027E EPS of NT$25 to derive a target price of NT$800. We value Dynapack based on 2027E
                        target P/E as we believe 2027E better reflects its earnings power after BBU capacity expansion. Our target P/E of 32x is based
                        on our forecast EPS CAGR of 66% in 2025-2027E and a PEG of 0.5x, which we benchmark against its major PSU partner, as we
                        expect Dynapack to grow alongside its partner.


                        Risks
                        Our quantitative model assigns a High Risk rating to Dynapack. However, we believe such a rating is not warranted for
                        Dynapack due to: 1) the company is generating solid revenue and earnings growth over next 3 years; the underlying industry,
                        BBU for AIDC, also enjoys secular growth; 2) the business model that involves with product customization and strict
                        safety/reliability requirements would imply relatively benign competition and therefore stable pricing and margins; and 3) the
                        company has a strong balance sheet and has been in net cash position since 2019.

                        Key downside risks to our price target/rating are: 1) Slower-than-expected BBU adoption in AIDC, 2) Delay in PSU customer
                        qualifications, 3) Competition from larger battery or power solution vendors, 4) Safety, certification and reliability issues.


                        Panasonic Holdings
                        (6752.T; ¥3957.0; 1; 16 Oct 26; 15:30)


                        Valuation
                        To derive our target price, we use a global sum-of-the-parts (SoTP) approach. In the case of Panasonic Holdings, we reference
                        52 other companies in the Citi coverage universe to set a fair value PER for each business division, which we sum to derive our
                        overall target price.
                        Panasonic fair-value PERs for individual business segments range from 8x to 31x, and have a weighted average of 26.2x
                        (excluding subsidies in the battery business), taking minority interest and equity in earnings into account. We estimate
                        business-derived equity value of ¥5,000/share. We calculate the present value of the amount we expect Panasonic to receive
                        in battery subsidies over five years at ¥400/share. Combining these two values, we derive a target price of ¥5,400.


                        Risks
                        Risks to our target price include 1) unsuccessful management policies or strategies resulting in weaker-than-expected
                        business investment returns or sales growth, or conversely producing greater-than-expected results at a relatively early stage,
                        2) stagnation in the global economy or an upturn in it, and rises or declines in demand in the electrical industry, and 3) forex
                        trends. If these factors manifest themselves differently than we have anticipated, the share price may vary from our target
                        price.

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
For the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM


                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs
                                              for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics).
                                              For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.

                                              M&A Rank
                                              Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary
                                              across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
                                              companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
                                              representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
                                              departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not
                                              factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

                        Dynapack International
                        Valuation
                        We assign a 32x target P/E to our 2027E EPS of NT$25 to derive a target price of NT$800. We value Dynapack based on 2027E
                        target P/E as we believe 2027E better reflects its earnings power after BBU capacity expansion. Our target P/E of 32x is based
                        on our forecast EPS CAGR of 66% in 2025-2027E and a PEG of 0.5x, which we benchmark against its major PSU partner, as we
                        expect Dynapack to grow alongside its partner.


                        Risks
                        Our quantitative model assigns a High Risk rating to Dynapack. However, we believe such a rating is not warranted for
                        Dynapack due to: 1) the company is generating solid revenue and earnings growth over next 3 years; the underlying industry,
                        BBU for AIDC, also enjoys secular growth; 2) the business model that involves with product customization and strict
                        safety/reliability requirements would imply relatively benign competition and therefore stable pricing and margins; and 3) the
                        company has a strong balance sheet and has been in net cash position since 2019.

                        Key downside risks to our price target/rating are: 1) Slower-than-expected BBU adoption in AIDC, 2) Delay in PSU customer
                        qualifications, 3) Competition from larger battery or power solution vendors, 4) Safety, certification and reliability issues.


                        Panasonic Holdings
                        (6752.T; ¥3957.0; 1; 16 Oct 26; 15:30)


                        Valuation
                        To derive our target price, we use a global sum-of-the-parts (SoTP) approach. In the case of Panasonic Holdings, we reference
                        52 other companies in the Citi coverage universe to set a fair value PER for each business division, which we sum to derive our
                        overall target price.
                        Panasonic fair-value PERs for individual business segments range from 8x to 31x, and have a weighted average of 26.2x
                        (excluding subsidies in the battery business), taking minority interest and equity in earnings into account. We estimate
                        business-derived equity value of ¥5,000/share. We calculate the present value of the amount we expect Panasonic to receive
                        in battery subsidies over five years at ¥400/share. Combining these two values, we derive a target price of ¥5,400.


                        Risks
                        Risks to our target price include 1) unsuccessful management policies or strategies resulting in weaker-than-expected
                        business investment returns or sales growth, or conversely producing greater-than-expected results at a relatively early stage,
                        2) stagnation in the global economy or an upturn in it, and rises or declines in demand in the electrical industry, and 3) forex
                        trends. If these factors manifest themselves differently than we have anticipated, the share price may vary from our target
                        price.

                                                                                          Greater China Technology Hardware
Higher bandwidth and better power efficiency: In the networking space, the               Asia Pacific
                                                                                         Industry View                   In-Line
migration into higher bandwidth continues, as players like Accton and Celestica
showcased their 1.6T network switches. We think a bigger theme is the effort to
improve the power efficiency of current mainstream pluggable optical solutions.
First off, one well-discussed approach is the adoption CPO or NPO, and it seems the
latter is gaining more attention due to the technical challenges in the former. Spec
standardization, such as CPX connectors, could further accelerate the proliferation,
in our view. Secondly, copper could still help, as Credo has its 1.6T AEC cables for
inter-tray transmission while many other vendors (Amphenol, TE Connectivity,
Molex, etc.) have their 448G CPC solutions for in-tray transmission. Lastly, the micro
VCSEL based optical modules from Credo and ALAB represent another power
efficient solution (12W/end at 1,6T), which has reliability comparable to copper
(100M hours of MTBF/MTBI) for a transmission distance of 50-100m. We believe
this micro VCSEL based solution could potentially replace the AEC for shorter
distance transmission when copper hits the physical limit in the medium term and
be integrated with the CPO architecture in the longer term. In sum, we believe the
above-mentioned solutions are likely to co-exist for different use cases.

800VDC for power delivery taking the center stage: While the Vera Rubin NVL72
rack already has the in-rack power shelf reference design (110KW/shelf at 3+1
redundancy), Nvidia unveiled another reference design this time, using one 660KW
800VDC power rack to support two Vera Rubin NVL72 racks. Moreover, we also
saw a few ±400VDC reference designs as well. Our conversations with companies
on the exhibition floor indicate that the HVDC adoption should start from late
2026, but likely at a small scale extending into 2027. The next checkpoint will be
Vera Rubin Ultra racks, where increasing power consumption and more hardware
devices for inter-rack scale-up network might take up more pace on the rack, though
the liquid cooled power shelf should ease the space budget a bit. We believe both
solutions are progressing and will closely monitor the dynamics.

2026 OCP Global Summit
                                                   Networking dealing with higher bandwidth and better power
                                                   efficiency

                                                   1.6T network switch and 1.6T transceiver/AEC

                                                   CPO remains one of the focus in the networking space during the OCP Global Summit.
                                                   Edgecore and Celestica showcased its 1.6T network switches based on Tomahawk 6 ASIC,
                                                   both for the regular model and the CPO model. Moreover, Edgecore also had its OCS
                                                   switch model in the booth, which is based on its own LCOS technology. These
                                                   demonstrate that both have the capability to accommodate the customer demand for
                                                   network switches based on the optical architecture in the future.

                                                   On the cable side, Credo showcased its 1.6T AEC, but did not comment on the roadmap of
                                                   its 3.2T AEC. Our checks in the exhibition with industry players indicate that the 3.2T AEC
                                                   might be a very challenging project, though efforts are still in place.

                                    CPX and NPX all marching forward

                                    Though CPO remains as the holy grail in the space, its yield issue and lower serviceability
                                    still present challenges to the wider adoption in the near term. We believe that the efforts
                                    will continue, but the industry is simultaneously pursuing other more practical solutions
                                    to sort out the power consumption issue of the existing pluggable transceivers, including
                                    NPO (near-packaged optics), CPC (co-packaged copper) and NPC (near-packaged copper)

                                    Compared to CPO, NPO compromises on the power consumption, but in exchange it eases
                                    the stringent requirement on alignment and serviceability. Given its better technology
                                    readiness and more mature supply chain, we think it might see good traction in the
                                    coming years.

                                    Power becoming another bottleneck in the AI deployment

                                    HVDC adoption emerging from Vera Rubin

                                    In the power space, HVDC has been one of the key focuses in the AI cluster, as the rapid
                                    increase in AI rack power density is creating growing challenges for conventional power-
                                    distribution architectures. As rack-level power consumption rising from tens of kilowatts
                                    to several hundreds of KWs, electrical losses, cable size, thermal management
                                    requirements, and overall system complexity increase significantly. Under traditional low-
                                    voltage power architectures, delivering larger amounts of power requires proportionally
                                    higher current, which increases resistive losses and places greater stress on cables,
                                    connectors, busbars, and power-conversion equipment.

                                    At the same time, every power-conversion stage introduces efficiency losses and
                                    generates additional heat. As AI deployments scale into multi-megawatt and eventually
                                    gigawatt-level campuses, even small efficiency improvements can translate into

                                              meaningful reductions in operating costs, cooling requirements, and infrastructure
                                              investment. Consequently, the industry is increasingly focused on power architectures
                                              that can reduce conversion stages, lower current levels, and improve overall power-
                                              delivery efficiency.

                                              Against this backdrop, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) is emerging as one of the most
                                              important architectural upgrades for next-generation AI infrastructure. By increasing
                                              distribution voltage, HVDC allows the same amount of power to be delivered at a lower
                                              current, reducing conduction losses and improving system efficiency. Higher-voltage
                                              architectures also improve scalability for ultra-high-density rack deployments by
                                              alleviating some of the physical and thermal constraints associated with conventional
                                              power-distribution systems.

     Looking further ahead, Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) represent a potential next-
     generation evolution of power infrastructure. Unlike traditional transformers that operate
     primarily as passive devices, SSTs leverage power electronics to provide voltage
     conversion, power conditioning, and bidirectional energy management within a single
     platform. This enables greater controllability and flexibility while supporting increasingly
     digitalized power networks.

     Although SSTs remain at an early stage of commercialization and face challenges related
     to economics, reliability, and large-scale deployment, the technology aligns well with long-
     term data center trends. As AI campuses evolve into utility-scale power consumers
     incorporating energy storage, distributed generation, and advanced power management,
     SSTs could eventually become a key enabling technology.

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).

items.text:
台灣股市｜電子

                                                  事件分析


Fubon Research            TPCA Show 2026 有哪些看點？
2026 年 10 月 16 日
                          高效能革命 從運算核心到智慧應用

                          1. AI 算力帶動高階載板需求
                          2. 先進封裝成主軸：玻璃基板、TGV 躍居焦點
                          3. 欣興、景碩；材料供應商 — Nittobo、Resonac、MGC 成為焦點


                          AI 算力帶動高階載板需求
                          TPCA Show 2026 以「高效能革命 從運算核心到智慧應用」為主題。展覽範疇涵
                          蓋 PCB 製造、電子產業生態系與綠色科技等主題，並新增先進封裝主題專區，聚焦
                          「AI × PCB ×先進封裝」
                                         。AI、資料中心與高效能運算（HPC）需求激增，帶動 ABF
資料來源：TPCA
                          載板與先進封裝材料規格升級。此供應鏈正由傳統 PCB 製造轉向半導體封裝，使今
黃韻庭                       年 TPCA Show 成為歷屆技術含量最高的一屆。
yunting.huang@fubon.com
886-2-27815995#37117
                          先進封裝成主軸：玻璃基板、TGV 躍居焦點

李耿聿
                          本屆展會聚焦玻璃核心基板（GCS）、CoWoS/FOPLP 相關設備與材料，以及以異
aaron.gy.li@fubon.com     質整合為導向的技術。隨著先進封裝尺寸持續放大，封裝所需的尺寸穩定性、共平
886-2-27815995#37107      面性與低膨脹/收縮特性亟需提升。傳統 ABF 載板的核心板向來著重於補強纖維與
                          填料。為降低高應力與高溫下的翹曲，系統廠近年提出修改核心板結構，帶動市場
                          高度關注玻璃基板技術。


                          玻璃核心具備高剛性、優異平坦度與低熱膨脹係數（CTE）
                                                    ，被視為次世代高階載板
                          的潛力選項。然而，玻璃基板仍處於技術驗證與供應鏈建置階段，TGV（玻璃通孔）
                          金屬化一致性、材料脆性及可靠度驗證等挑戰仍待克服。初期應用預期集中在 AI
                          GPU 與 ASIC 等高功耗晶片。展會熱度升溫與實際營收貢獻間存在明顯落差，廠商
                          於展覽期間釋出的技術細節，將是衡量此落差最直接的指標。


                          欣興、景碩；材料供應商 — Nittobo、Resonac、MGC 成為焦點
                          今年展會首度設置先進封裝主題專區，涵蓋玻璃基板、TGV、面板級封裝、異質整
                          合與 CPO，並有超過 40 場論壇。開幕首日，欣興（3037 TT，買進）董事長簡山
                          傑將發表主題演講「異質整合時代下的台灣 PCB 產業：從供應鏈走向生態系」
                                                              。景
                          碩（3189 TT，買進）亦將針對玻璃基板進行演講，主題為「先進封裝玻璃材料應用
                          的解析」
                             ，內容聚焦封裝尺寸放大所帶來的尺寸穩定性、共平面性及抗翹曲需求，以
                          及玻璃基板技術的發展背景。景碩是今年論壇中唯一由資深技術主管公開演講的 IC
                          載板廠，可作為評估產業進展的指標。


                          在材料方面，Nittobo 將展示其銷售策略與玻纖布開發的未來趨勢，如次世代特殊
                          玻璃（包含 Low Dk 玻璃與 Low CTE 玻璃）以及以其獨家技術開發的超薄玻纖布。
                          Resonac 將主打高效能半導體封裝材料、先進銅箔基板（CCL）
                                                          ，以及專為 AI 晶片
                          與高效能運算（HPC）打造的樹脂技術，並提供用於高密度連接（HDI）與 IC 載板
                          的特用化學品解決方案。MGC 則預計展示業界領先的 ultra-low Dk/Df 材料、BT
                          樹脂及針對 5G、資料中心、AI 伺服器設計的高階銅箔基板，以及先進半導體製造
                          的高純度電子化學品。

MediaTek (MDTKF)
Our PO of NT$6,200 is based on 24x 2H27-1H28 P/E. which is towards the higher end
of its historical P/E range of 8-25x, as we believe the company's broadening ASIC
pipeline could drive an earnings upgrade cycle.

Upside risks to our PO are: (1) better than expected smartphone demand, especially in
China, (2) a better pricing in mobile communication segment thanks to alleviated
competition and rising exposure to high-end/flagship market, and (3) an even more
superior investment return on non-op side to uplift its net cash position. (4) Unexpected
collaboration with global technology leaders leads to higher than expected
margins/profits

Downside risks to our PO are: (1) weaker-than-expected end-market situation in
consumer-related smartphone/TV space, (2) macro challenges including inflation/policy-
related pressures, (3) rising competition from existing players and/or newcomers in
smartphone/TV SoC (system on chip) space, and (4) ASP/margin pressure caused by each
or all of the above and/or rising foundry costs. (4) Bidding process for Meta Inference
ASIC is slower than expected.

                                                                                                                                                                     irene.chang@ubs.com
hold the fiber in position when it is connected to a switch adapter or removable cable.                                                                                 +886-2-8722 7280
Genius collaboration with 3M can bring the company closer to the end demand with its
direct partnership with Microsoft and bring revenue contribution forward to 2027,
ahead of Genius CPO ramp in 2028E. For CPO, we still see potential to reach 10% of the
TAM supplying MT ferrule, prism and V-groove.

Reiterate Buy with PT at NT$1,250
Our recent update on Genius had raised the PT from NT$700 to NT$1,250 reflecting the
company's potential CPO market with its progress sampling three precision components
inside the fiber array unit (FAU) targeting FAU integrators such as Coherent and FOCI.
The collaboration strengthens our confidence on Genius capability within the optical
connectivity industry, and reiterate our Buy on the compony.

Company Description
Founded in 1989, Genius Electronic Optical (GSEO) is a leading global manufacturer of
camera lenses, providing full service optical solutions, including mobile lenses, automotive
lenses and AR/VR optics. Its production sites are in Taichung (one plant) and Xiamen (two
plants). The Taichung plant mainly manufactures VR lenses, while the Xiamen plants produce
compact lenses for consumer electronics. Optical lens products accounted for 73% of 2023
total revenue, and others include TOF lenses, flash lenses, VR lenses and LED lighting
products. Its major client is Apple and it supplies lenses for iPhones and iPads.

UBS EPS and Consensus EPS
The UBS EPS is an adjusted diluted EPS metric. It is calculated using the UBS analyst's
interpretation of earnings suitable for valuation purposes divided by the diluted number of
shares. This may differ to the way the consensus EPS metric has been calculated.

Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Our price target is based on PE-based sum-of-the-parts model.
Genius' growth is highly leveraged to the overall handset industry and could be affected by
volatility in handset demand, as well as whether handset OEMs will continue upgrading their
camera design. Genius' margins could be affected by increasing competition and the rise of
new technologies, ASP pressure from customers and fluctuating material and labour costs.
Downside risks include competitors catching up in technology, yield rate issues for new
products and uncertain iPhone demand.

Equity Research
                                                                                                                                 15 October 2026 | 7:29PM CST

                                                  ASIA TECHNOLOGY

                                                 BT substrates industry update: Structural changes in S/D conditions;
                                                 raise ZDT/Kinsus/NYPCB/Unimicron TPs to NT$1,025/1,515/2,700/1,270


                                              Better-than-expected BT substrate pricing outlook with more favorable                   Chao Wang
                                                                                                                                      +886(2)2730-4195 | kuan-
                                              supply/demand balance                                                                   chao.wang@gs.com
                                                                                                                                      Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C., Taipei
                                                                                                                                      Branch
                                              We update our BT substrate industry model (last updated in 2021 - see here) to
                                                                                                                                      Allen Chang
                                              factor in: (1) Solid memory substrate demand (41% 2026-28E CAGR; accounting             +852-2978-2930 |
                                                                                                                                      allen.k.chang@gs.com
                                              for 68%/74% of total BT substrate TAM in 2026/27E); and (2) a slower capacity           Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C.

                                              growth rate vs. the previous upcycle in 2020-22 (6% 2026-28E CAGR vs. 9%                Al Wang
                                                                                                                                      +886(2)2730-4081 | al.wang@gs.com
                                              2020-22 CAGR) as key Asian BT substrate suppliers continue to transfer capacity         Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C., Taipei
                                                                                                                                      Branch
                                              from BT substrates to ABF substrates over the coming quarters/years. Our model
For the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM


                                              now suggests the BT substrate industry supply/demand gap will widen to
                                              11%/14% in 2027/28E from 1% in 2026E, while overall BT substrate TAM will
                                              expand at a 32% 2026-28E CAGR. While BT substrate pricing rose by 10% on
                                              average in 2026, we expect BT substrate suppliers ZDT/Kinsus/NYPCB/Unimicron to
                                              see BT pricing increase by 26%/41%/38%/32% in 2027E and an additional
                                              15%/26%/28%/27% in 2028E. Consequently, these companies’ BT substrate profits
                                              should grow at a 46%/73%/75%/35% CAGR in 2026-28E.

                                              Optical transceiver mSAP demand ramp-up expands TAM for BT substrate
                                              players

                                              We are seeing increasing adoption of mSAP technology in optical transceivers to
                                              produce connectivity PCBs. This trend continues to increase demand for
                                              substrate-related equipment, tightening supply across the broader BT & mSAP


                                                                                                                                                                            e92c7a75ab8b4efbba794e6b187208c8
                                              industry. Our industry checks suggest that mSAP is the most supply-constrained
                                              component in the 1.6T optical transceiver supply chain, and we expect this shortage
                                              will continue to drive mSAP product pricing up by at least 10%-20% over the next 12

                                              GS Factor Profile
                                              The Goldman Sachs Factor Profile provides investment context for a stock by comparing key attributes to the market (i.e. our universe of rated stocks)
                                              and its sector peers. The four key attributes depicted are: Growth, Financial Returns, Multiple (e.g. valuation) and Integrated (a composite of Growth,
                                              Financial Returns and Multiple). Growth, Financial Returns and Multiple are calculated by using normalized ranks for specific metrics for each stock. The
                                              normalized ranks for the metrics are then averaged and converted into percentiles for the relevant attribute. The precise calculation of each metric may
                                              vary depending on the fiscal year, industry and region, but the standard approach is as follows:
                                              Growth is based on a stock’s forward-looking sales growth, EBITDA growth and EPS growth (for financial stocks, only EPS and sales growth), with a
                                              higher percentile indicating a higher growth company. Financial Returns is based on a stock’s forward-looking ROE, ROCE and CROCI (for financial
                                              stocks, only ROE), with a higher percentile indicating a company with higher financial returns. Multiple is based on a stock’s forward-looking P/E, P/B,
                                              price/dividend (P/D), EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF and EV/Debt Adjusted Cash Flow (DACF) (for financial stocks, only P/E, P/B and P/D), with a higher percentile
                                              indicating a stock trading at a higher multiple. The Integrated percentile is calculated as the average of the Growth percentile, Financial Returns
                                              percentile and (100% - Multiple percentile).
For the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM


                                              Financial Returns and Multiple use the Goldman Sachs analyst forecasts at the fiscal year-end at least three quarters in the future. Growth uses inputs
                                              for the fiscal year at least seven quarters in the future compared with the year at least three quarters in the future (on a per-share basis for all metrics).
                                              For a more detailed description of how we calculate the GS Factor Profile, please contact your GS representative.

                                              M&A Rank
                                              Across our global coverage, we examine stocks using an M&A framework, considering both qualitative factors and quantitative factors (which may vary
                                              across sectors and regions) to incorporate the potential that certain companies could be acquired. We then assign a M&A rank as a means of scoring
                                              companies under our rated coverage from 1 to 3, with 1 representing high (30%-50%) probability of the company becoming an acquisition target, 2
                                              representing medium (15%-30%) probability and 3 representing low (0%-15%) probability. For companies ranked 1 or 2, in line with our standard
                                              departmental guidelines we incorporate an M&A component into our target price. M&A rank of 3 is considered immaterial and therefore does not
                                              factor into our price target, and may or may not be discussed in research.

Equity Research
Sector Report | Overseas Technology｜Oct 15,2026


PTFE Adoption:                                                                                        Overseas
                                                                                                      Technology
Reshape the High-End Materials Landscape
 Michelle Jing                         Jeff Pu, CFA
 SFC CE No. BUK594                     SFC CE No. BNO719
 michellejing@gfgroup.com.hk           jeffpu@gfgroup.com.hk


What's new

Nvidia showcased its NVLink PTFE board prototype for the first time at OCP Global Summit 2026, highlighting seven supply-chain partners:
Taiflex (8039 TT), Flexium (6269 TT), TTM Technologies (TTMI US), 3 leading Chinese PCB manufacturers, and 1 leading Chinese CCL
supplier. We believe this development reinforces our previous view that PTFE remains the most promising material solution for the VR300
NVL576 switch board, offering the best balance between electrical performance and MP feasibility.

Comments

PTFE hybrid remains the preferred solution: As highlighted in our Oct. 5 report, we continue to favor the PTFE hybrid solution for the
VR300 NVL576 switch board among the various options, given its optimal balance between electrical performance and MP feasibility.
While pure PTFE remains challenging to process, particularly in lamination and drilling, leading PCB manufacturers have achieved
encouraging yields with hybrid structures that combine PTFE signal layers with M9 materials in non-signal layers.

We like PTFE's long-term adoption potential: PTFE applications in high-frequency and high-speed interconnects could extend beyond
switch boards. The IEC has published a standard on PTFE-filled CCL, led by the leading Chinese CCL company, highlighting the material's
relevance to broader circuit-board applications. Our checks also suggest that PTFE materials have entered the testing phase for other
applications, including compute boards. We therefore remain positive on PTFE's long-term adoption across a broader range of high-end
PCB applications.

Limited near-term impact on conventional resin materials, but long-term substitution risks warrant attention: Under the current
PTFE hybrid design, we expect 8–12 out of 32 layers to adopt PTFE for signal transmission, accounting for less than 50% of the total CCL
resin content value. Over the longer term, we expect a potential shift toward pure PTFE solutions as improvements in processing
technology enable commercially viable MP yields, reducing the need for hybrid structures. This could gradually increase substitution risks
for conventional high-end PCB resin materials, including PPO and HC resin.

Favor PTFE-exposed suppliers with proven technical and manufacturing capabilities: We remain positive on PTFE-related
opportunities, particularly suppliers with strong R&D capabilities, proven MP expertise, and established customer qualifications. In CCL,
we favor Taiflex (8039 TT) and leading Chinese CCL supplier for their PTFE material capabilities and supply-chain exposure. Among the
five Nvidia-announced PCB suppliers, we favor the leading Chinese PTFE PCB supplier, given its advanced hybrid PTFE processing
capabilities and encouraging yields. For CCL suppliers that have yet to enter the PTFE supply chain, we recommend monitoring progress
in developing, while remaining alert to potential market-share losses in their conventional product portfolios.

Risks

1) AI demand slowing down; 2) Geo-political risks; 3) Competition.

個股報告
2026/10/16

台積電 2330 TT （電子-半導體）

積厚成勢，晶耀巔峰

強力買進－維持強力買進

目標價：3,320 元　+36.1%
收盤價：2,440.00 元

投資與評價

1. 台積電 3Q26 受惠 AI GPU、ASIC、CPU 及網通晶片需求強勁，HPC 營收季增 22%，N2 營收占比提升至 8%，營運創新高；4Q26 隨 N2 於新竹及高雄持續快速放量，N3 維持高稼動率，營運續創歷史新高。

2. 台積電 26 年受惠 AI/HPC 需求強勁，N3 維持高稼動、N2 加速放量，A16 於 2H26 量產，CoWoS 產能持續擴充，預估 EPS 110.83 元；預估 27 年 N2 年產能達 2.4 倍，台灣南科及美國亞利桑那 N3 新廠陸續量產，AI 加速器與 Agentic AI 需求續增，EPS 151.11 元。

3. 目前台積電股價交易在 2,440 元(16.1X 27(F) PER)，位於近三年歷史本益比參考區間 12～26x 中間偏下位置，因 2 奈米量產爬坡以及海外廠折舊稀釋，27 年毛利率將小幅衰退，本益比由中間偏上之 23 倍下調至 22 倍，因調高 27 年獲利預估，故維持強力買進投資建議，目標價由 3,220 元(23x 修正前 FY27E EPS)調升至 3,320 元(22x 修正後 FY27E EPS)。

重點更新

台積電 3Q26 受惠 AI 及先進製程需求強勁，優於預期且創歷史新高

N2 製程自 4Q25 量產後持續擴大產能，帶動 3Q26 HPC 與智慧型手機營收分別季增 22%及 10%，占整體營收比重達 68%及 21%。在先進製程占比提升及晶圓出貨量增加帶動下，營收 1,494 億元(+17.6% QoQ)。雖然 N3 產能利用率維持高檔，加上整體營運規模持續擴大，惟 N2 初期量產仍面臨較高的製造成 本與折舊負擔，形成稀釋，但稀釋程度低於我們原先預期。毛利率 66.4%(-1.3ppts QoQ)，營業利益 8,764.45 億元(+15.1% QoQ)，稅後淨利 7,633.41 億元(+8.0% QoQ)，EPS 29.43 元，優於預期且創歷史新高。

預期台積電 4Q26 受惠 AI 需求持續擴張，N2 放量推升營運再創新高

隨 CSP 持續增加 AI 基礎建設投資，AI 加速器、Agentic AI 相關 CPU 及網通晶片對先進製程的需求持續增加，上修 4Q26 營收預估 9.5%至 1,699 兆元(+13.8% QoQ)。N2 處於快速擴產階段，初期量產成本及新增折舊仍對毛利率形成壓力，加上海外晶圓廠持續稀釋毛利率，但先進製程需求強勁有助維持高產能利用率，且 N3 製程量產規模擴大，小幅上調毛利率預估 0.1 個百分點至 66.3%(-0.1ppts QoQ)。調高營業利益至 9,911.86 億元(+13.1% QoQ)，上修稅後淨利至 8,315.29 億元(+8.9% QoQ)，EPS 32.07 元，營運續創歷史新高。

國泰期貨 國泰證券子公司

投資 顧問
產業報告
2026/10/16

產業更新－衛星產業

SpaceX D2C 進展更進一步，星艦試射進展順利

What’s New－SpaceX 收購新頻譜，劍指行動通訊市場

SpaceX於10/8宣布收購Grain Management旗下全美800MHz低頻頻譜，涵蓋最多14MHz配對頻譜，交易金額估約80億美元。800MHz具備廣域覆蓋及室內穿透優勢，可與既有2GHz頻譜互補，改善偏遠地區通訊品質。儘管仍待FCC核准，惟主席Brendan Carr對新業者投資持正面態度，預期有利交易推進。

Trends/Outlook－衛星、火箭升級短期影響衛星部署速度

3Q26 SpaceX共完成22次Starlink低軌衛星部署任務，合計發射578顆衛星，季減16.8%。9M26累計部署2,167顆。單季發射數量下滑主要受任務頻率減少影響，惟單次平均部署26.3顆，略高於2Q26的25.7顆。此外，SpaceX於9月成功透過Starship部署26顆新一代V3衛星，顯示大型運載火箭逐步具備實際除衛星部署能力。另一方面，Amazon Leo於3Q26僅完成1次發射任務，部署29顆衛星，季減81.3%，主要受運載火箭供應及發射排程限制，後續須觀察Vulcan、Ariane 6及New Glenn等新一代火箭投入商業發射的進度。SpaceX另規劃於路易斯安那州興建全球第四座太空港，預計2027年動工、2029年首飛，規劃設置逾12座發射塔，全面達成後目標每年支援數千次Starship飛行任務。

Investment Summary

1. 研究部認為，EchoStar交易解決了Starlink下一代D2C的頻譜與容量問題，而近期收購Grain Management旗下全美800MHz低頻頻譜，則進一步補強低頻地面覆蓋資源。有了自有頻譜資源，搭配未來新一代D2C衛星團輔載之升級，SpaceX已逐步豐富期衛星寬頻業者，走向整合型行動通訊服務供應商的完整資源。

2. 維持SpaceX 26/27年新增4,000/6,000顆衛星預期不變，儘管3Q26新增數略低於預期，短期受到新世代衛星、火箭轉換，影響現階段Falcon 9星鏈任務次數部屬，惟考量下一代V3衛星試射順利，4Q26有望啟動部屬，單次Starlink低軌衛星發射數量上限將由29顆大幅上升至60顆，將有益於未來衛星成長在加速，故持續看好天上衛星供應鏈如華通(2313 TT)、昇達科(3491 TT)、耀華(2367 TT)後市發展。

                    NB 需求疲弱，我們預期 4Q26 無旺季效應，出貨將持續季減及年減。

              2027 年伺服器需求成長維持強勁
              1H26 AI 伺服器需求優於預期。全球伺服器出貨成長於 2Q26 加速至年增
              26%，高於 1Q26 的年增 18%，主要受惠 2Q26 通用型伺服器及 AI 伺服器
              出貨量均達年增 20-30% (圖 13)。不過，根據 Gartner 資料，2Q26 AI 伺服
              器出貨量較前季下滑，我們認為新舊機種世代轉換應為其一主因。2Q26 通用
              型伺服器營收年增 150%，對比 AI 伺服器營收年增 70%，主因為零組件大幅
              漲價，尤其是記憶體價格上升所帶動 (圖 14)。1H26 AI 伺服器占全球伺服器
              總出貨量 22%、佔營收 69%，對比 1H25 之 18%及 72% (圖 15-16)。AI 伺
              服器出貨優於我們原先預期，而通用型伺服器出貨則低於預期，主因記憶體、
              CPU 及硬碟等關鍵零組件供應持續吃緊。在零組件成本上升帶動下，1H26
              伺服器綜合 ASP 年增 52%至 4.32 萬美元。其中，通用型伺服器 ASP 年增 78%
              至約 1.7 萬美元，AI 伺服器 ASP 則年增 14%至 13.3 萬美元 (圖 17-19)。受
              惠 CSP 對 AI 伺服器及通用型伺服器的強勁需求，自建 ODM 直供模式出貨占
              比由 1H25 的 31%提升至 1H26 的 42%，營收占比亦由 48%提升至 52% (圖
              20-24)。由於多數 AI 伺服器需求來自美國 CSP，美國於 1H26 的伺服器出貨
              成長最為強勁，2Q26 年增率由 1Q26 的 35%進一步加速至 53%，帶動 1H26
              整體年增 44%。因此，美國已成為全球最大的伺服器市場，全球市占率達
              41%，高於中國的 28%、歐洲／中東／非洲地區 (EMEA) 的 18%，以及亞
              太地區的 8%。品牌廠方面，Lenovo (中)、Inspur (中) 及 Dell (美) 為 1H26
              全球前三大伺服器品牌，出貨量分別年增 34%、14% 及 6%，市占率則分別
              達 7.2%、8% 及 10% (圖 38)。1H26 全球伺服器市場受惠於出貨量成長及
              ASP 提升，表現強勁。我們預期此趨勢將延續至 2H26-2027 年，主要受 AI
              伺服器 ASP 持續攀升及零組件成本上漲帶動。

              AI 與通用型伺服器需求於 2H26-2027 年維持強勁，但零組件供應仍為潛在
              限制。隨著 CSP 持續擴建 AI 基礎設施並加大模型開發投資，以因應訓練、代
              理式 AI 及推論型 AI 的強勁需求，且 2026-27 年資本支出持續成長，我們預
              期 AI 伺服器與通用型伺服器需求將於 2H26-2027 年維持強勁成長，其中 CSP
              與 Neocloud 業者將是最主要的需求來源 (圖 25-28)。市場也預期,超大規模雲
              端業者(hyperscalers)的 AI 伺服器資本支出水準，將從 2025 年到 2030 年預
              估成長至三倍以上。AI 伺服器方面，隨著新一代 AI 晶片陸續量產，將進一步
              帶動 2H26-2027 年出貨量成長。我們將 AI 伺服器出貨量預估上調至 2026 年
              的 350 萬台 (年增 49%) 及 2027 年的 520 萬台 (年增 46%)，對比 1H26 的
              170 萬台 (年增 56%)，主要反映需求強勁，以及組裝良率與生產效率持續改
              善(圖 35-36)。此預估主要建立於 AI 晶片供給持續擴張的基礎上。我們預估
              2027 年 Nvidia、AMD、AWS Trainium 與 Google TPU 的供貨量將分別達 900
              萬顆、168 萬顆、306 萬顆及 910 萬顆，高於 2026 年的 850 萬顆、86 萬顆、
              240 萬顆及 400 萬顆。預期 GB／VR NVL72 機櫃出貨量將於 2026 年達約 6.9
              萬櫃，2027 年增至 8 萬櫃，另 HGX 平台出貨約 15 萬櫃。Nvidia 將持續為
              AI 伺服器晶片的主要供應商，但明年市占率可能下滑至 50%以下(圖 31-32)。
              另一方面，我們認為 AWS 與 Google 將受惠於市場對平價、客製化推論型 AI
              解決方案的需求，於 2026-27 年主導 ASIC AI 市場，且市占率持續提升 (圖
              30-32)。而 AMD 雖在 AI 伺服器處理器市場的市占率預期持續提升，但我們
              認為其市占率於 2026-2027 年仍將低於 10%。因此，我們預估 AI 伺服器占
              全球伺服器總出貨量比重將由 2025 年的 19%、2026 年的 23%，進一步提

              頭廠商將持續成為 AI 的主要受惠者。

              ASIC 伺服器將成為 2027 年主要成長動能。 預期自 2H26 起，隨著新一代
              ASIC 晶片陸續推出，包括 AWS 的 Trainium 3 及 Google 的 TPU v8，ASIC 伺
              服器出貨將明顯擴張。為滿足客製化推論 AI 需求，晶片出貨成長預計於 2027
              年進一步加速。此外，Meta 自研 ASIC 晶片 MTIA 的量產明年亦將加速，雖
              然目前出貨規模仍相對較小。根據我們預估，2027 年 Trainium 晶片出貨量
              將年增 26%至 306 萬顆，TPU 出貨量則可望大幅成長 126%至 910 萬顆。在
              此趨勢下，相關零組件供應商將是主要受惠族群，尤其是液冷散熱、電源與
              AEC、電源供應器、CCL／PCB／載板，以及交換器與 OCS 業者。具體受惠
              業者包括奇鋐、台達電、智邦、貿聯-KY、台光電、金像電、欣興、緯穎及鴻
              海。

              2027 年通用型伺服器需求將維持強勁，儘管零組件供應緊張仍是潛在風險。
              代理型 AI (agentic AI)的興起,將推升 CPU 需求,因為這類系統需要對自主任務
              進行協調與調度(orchestration)。基於代理式 AI 與推論型 AI 需求持續成長，
              以及 CSP 資本支出展望與對 CPU 廠商下單動能強勁，我們預期 2027 年通用
              型伺服器出貨成長仍將維持強勁，且有望優於 2026 年。目前仍有多項零組
              件短缺影響出貨，但預期 CPU 產能將擴張，預期記憶體供應商將優先配置產
              能給伺服器市場。我們預估 2027 年全球伺服器 CPU 供給將成長逾 20%，主

              開始量產出貨所帶動。預期通用型伺服器出貨量將受惠換機需求及推論型 AI

                                                                                                PC 需求惡化，2027 年持續疲弱
                                                                                                3Q26 PC 出貨不如預期。根據 Gartner 統計，3Q26 全球 PC 出貨量年減 24%、
                                                                                                季減 14%至 5,540 萬台，較我們原估低 8%。華碩 PC 出貨量季增 7%，符合
                                                                                                公司展望，優於同業因電競 PC 比重較高，而此類客戶價格敏感度較低。然而，
                                                                                                其餘品牌出貨量均明顯季減。其中，Apple (美) 出貨量季減 23%，降幅最大，
                                                                                                因消費者趕在 6 月 MacBook 價格調漲 15-20%前，於 1H26 提前購買。HP (美)
                                                                                                因消費比重較高，PC 出貨量季減 20%；Dell (美)也因消費者提前購買而使出
                                                                                                貨量季減 19%。主要筆電 ODM 出貨亦受到拖累，其中仁寶 (2324 TT, NT$36.6,
                                                                                                未評等) 3Q26 筆電出貨量季減 21%、緯創季減 18%、廣達季減 17%。整體
                                                                                                而言，台灣前五大筆電 ODM 出貨量合計季減 17%。區域別來看，3Q26 亞
                                                                                                太地區 (不含日本) PC 出貨量僅季減 4%，優於其他地區，但歐非中東季減
                                                                                                17%、北美季減 22%。1Q-3Q26 全球 PC 出貨量年減 8%，其中亞太地區 (不
                                                                                                含日本) 僅年減 1%，美國年減 5%，優於其他區域。1-3Q26 各品牌中，Apple
                                                                                                出貨量年增 12%，優於同業，主因消費者於 1H26 提前購買。

                                                                                                4Q26 PC 出貨量季減，下修 2026 年 PC 需求預估。隨 DRAM 與 NAND 價格
                                                                                                3Q25 以來持續上漲，目前其成本占 PC BOM 比重已超過 40%，較 1Q25 的
                                                                                                15-20%大幅提升。1H26 Windows PC 零售價年增超過 30%，考量記憶體及
                                                                                                CPU 等零組件成本持續攀升，我們預期 3Q-4Q26 PC 價格再季增 5-10%，進
                                                                                                一步抑制 PC 需求。同時，我們觀察到 PC 品牌因消費需求疲弱，2H26 削減
                                                                                                PC 零組件 (如 IC) 訂單。多數台灣筆電 ODM 預期 4Q26 筆電出貨量持續季減，
                                                                                                我們預估 4Q26 前五大筆電 ODM 筆電出貨量季減 12%。反映消費需求低於
                                                                                                預期，我們下修 4Q26 全球 PC 出貨量預估至季減 12%、年減 33%，下修 2026
                                                                                                年全球 PC 出貨量至 2.32 億台，年減 14%。

                                                                                                2027 年 PC 需求仍疲軟。由於 1Q-4Q27 記憶體價格可能維持每季個位數漲
                                                                                                幅，PC 品牌為維持獲利能力，恐將持續調漲 PC 售價，或降低新機規格。此
                                                                                                外，2027 年 ODM 筆電新開案數至少年減 10-20%，PC 品牌可能延長既有機
                                                                                                種銷售週期。綜上，我們保守看待 2027 年 PC 需求，預期 1Q-2Q27 全球 PC
                                                                                                季度出貨量大致與 4Q26 持平，隱含年減幅 28%。我們認為 PC 需求於
                                                                                                3Q-4Q27 才可望逐季復甦，因低基期及新機上市使旺季出貨量逐步回升。我
                                                                                                們下修 2027 年全球 PC 需求預估至 2.05 億台，年減 12%。

  1 ToAlpha 觀點
  我們的六項判斷
  1. 樹脂系統分歧為未來兩年 CCL 產業最重要的結構變化，惟影響屬局部而非全面。PTFE 僅導入最高階互連板
     （NVL576 交換器板，並可能延伸至 Kyber 正交背板）；主流 AI 伺服器、ASIC 與網通板材之升級，仍沿 M8 → M9
     → M10 碳氫系路線推進。
  2. PTFE 與 HC 將分層並存，HC 並非過渡方案。PTFE 量產面臨三項限制：高溫壓合設備產能不足、混壓良率偏低、
     全球具量產經驗之 CCL 廠有限，短期內難以同時突破；碳氫系 M10、M11 的電性則持續逼近 PTFE。我們認為較可
     能的格局為 PTFE 據守最關鍵訊號層，其餘層別與其他板型由碳氫系主導。業界討論之終局架構為無布 PTFE，惟現
     階段交換器板仍採含玻纖布之混壓設計；無布碳氫材料則仍有剛性不足與熱翹曲問題待克服。
  3. 最確定的受益者在供給瓶頸，而非特定路線。無論何者勝出，高階玻纖布、HVLP 銅箔、鑽針與 CCL 報價調整均同
     步受益；PTFE 混壓良率愈低，單位良品耗用之材料與鑽針愈多。PTFE 路線另帶動 PTFE 樹脂與高溫壓合設備需
     求。
  4. 台系 CCL 廠的風險在高階份額上限，而非基本盤。基本情境之影響約為 2027 年共識淨利的 1～2%，遠低於報價調
     整效果；關鍵觀察變數為正交背板是否導入 PTFE，此將使最高階市場之定價權移轉至 PTFE 廠。Kyber 正交背板原
     設計即採 M9、石英布與 PTFE 混壓，惟 78 層壓合製造難度高，Kyber 已傳延後至 2028 年，設計仍可能調整。台
     系廠能否以碳氫系 M11 縮小與 PTFE 的電性差距，並與 PTFE 廠合作供應混壓材料，為降低此風險之關鍵。
  5. PTFE 新進者的營收彈性與風險皆源自低基期。以台虹為例，若成為 NVL576 第二供應商，單一專案可貢獻約 13 億
     元營收，約其近 12 個月營收的 12%；反之若 HC 勝出，該營收不會實現，呈二元結果。
  6. 競爭格局較市場預期開放。輝達於 2026 年 10 月 OCP 全球峰會揭示之 NVLink PTFE 合作供應商包括台虹與台郡，
     後者原屬軟板體系；產業訪談亦顯示，台燿與生益皆在開發供 Rubin Ultra 使用之 PTFE／M9 混壓材料，生益目前
     認證進度領先。展示名單不等同量產訂單，未列名者亦未必排除於供應鏈之外。我們預期 2026 年第四季至 2027 年
     第一季供應商名單方趨明朗，在此之前，不宜將任何一家視為確定之受益者或受壓者。

2 產業趨勢：CCL 升級的三條主軸
補強材與銅箔之升級方向明確，樹脂系統於 M9 之後分歧；分歧點恰落在輝達最高階互連板。
 等級升級即營收成長：產業訪談顯示，每張 CCL 報價約為 M6 80 美元、M7 90 美元、M8 130 美元，等級升級本身即帶
 動單價提升。台光電 2026 年 9 月營收 215.3 億元、年增 168.9%，前九月年增 103.7%，成長主要來自 M9 等高階 CCL
 出貨比重提升。台燿 2026 年第二季高速材料（ELL／SLL 與 VLL／LL）合計占銅箔基板營收約七成。
 上游成本大幅上升：產業訪談指出，過去半年銅箔上漲 50～60%、低 Dk 玻纖布上漲約 30%，一般 E 玻纖布漲幅更
 大，2027 年上半年可能再度調漲，CCL 報價預期於 2027 年第一、二季續漲。建滔亦於 2026 年 10 月 13 日針對使用
 2116（含）以下薄型玻纖布之 CCL 與半固化片調漲報價 15%，為其本年度第八次調價；HVLP4 銅箔供給吃緊。此為
 「瓶頸環節受益」的直接佐證。

  3 技術背景：CCL 結構與樹脂系統
PTFE 與 HC 皆為樹脂系統之選項，而非 CCL 之替代品；樹脂系統的選擇，決定高階 CCL 的供應商結構。
  CCL（銅箔基板）：由補強材（玻纖布）、樹脂系統與銅箔構成。玻纖布含浸樹脂後成為半固化片（Prepreg, PP），再與
  銅箔疊構、熱壓成型。PCB 廠以 CCL 與 PP 進行多層壓合、鑽孔與線路製作。
  Dk 與 Df：Dk（介電常數）影響訊號傳播速度與阻抗控制；Df（介電損耗因子）決定訊號傳輸損耗。傳輸速率愈高，Df
  要求愈嚴格。
  M 等級：業界慣以 M4～M10 區分高速 CCL 之損耗等級，等級愈高、Df 愈低。
  PTFE（聚四氟乙烯）：介電損耗最低，傳統應用於衛星、雷達、基地台等射頻領域。材料質軟、表面能低、熱膨脹係數
  （CTE）高，鑽孔、孔壁金屬化與壓合難度高；全 PTFE 多層板須以接近熔點之高溫熔合壓合。
  HC（碳氫樹脂）：分子極性低、損耗低，加工條件接近既有高速材料製程，為高階 CCL 主力樹脂系統之一；固化後脆性
  較高，需與 PPO 等樹脂改質以提升韌性。
  混壓（Hybrid stack-up）：於同一多層板中，僅在關鍵高速訊號層使用最高階材料，其餘層別採用成本較低、加工性較
  佳之材料；為 PTFE 導入高速數位板之主要形式。

 4 導入背景：NVL576 的規格門檻
輝達 Rubin Ultra 世代之 NVL576 將 8 個機櫃互連為單一系統，交換器板之損耗門檻下探至 Df 約 0.0004，現行碳氫系
M10 尚未完全達標，樹脂路線因而分歧。
1. 規格門檻：NVL576 交換器板與 Kyber 正交背板之損耗要求較現行 M8、M9 再嚴格一級；目前 M10 樣品略高於門檻，
   無布版本較接近。
2. 未全面採用 PTFE 之原因：全 PTFE 多層板須以高溫熔合壓合，且材料質軟、鑽孔困難，故採「M10＋PTFE 混壓」，由
   M10 提供結構剛性與加工性。
3. 交換器板用量增加：單櫃 NVL72 配置 9 片交換器板；NVL576 需跨櫃互連，我們預期交換器板數量顯著增加，混壓板中
   非 PTFE 層之碳氫系材料用量亦同步提升。
4. 主流機櫃不受影響：單櫃 NVL72 之運算板與交換器板未來兩至三年仍採 M8 以上之高速 CCL，並持續往 M9、M10 升
   級。
5. 時程：Rubin Ultra 預計 2027 年下半年量產，材料規格須於量產前一至兩季定案；碳氫系混壓方案亦在驗證，惟進度落
   後 PTFE。NVL576 亦存在延後或僅小量出貨之可能。
 5 PTFE vs HC 比較
PTFE 之優勢在電性，HC 之優勢在製程相容性、量產能力與供應鏈廣度。

   際落在 2027 年之影響較小，以 2028 年共識計之比例亦約低三分之一。
2. NVL576 世代 CCL 價值：ToAlpha 假設量產後年化價值 3～5 億美元（約 96～161 億元），PTFE 層約占價值一半（層數
   約三成，惟單價為一般層之 2～3 倍）。
3. 樂觀、基本：假設台系龍頭於碳氫系材料市占八成。樂觀：價值 × 80%；基本：非 PTFE 層（約一半）× 80% ＋ PTFE
   層（約一半）× 0～20%（兩成第二供應若由台系廠取得為 20%，若由台虹等新進者取得為 0）。兩者相差價值之 30～
   40%，即 29～64 億元。樂觀情境假設碳氫替代方案之單價與 PTFE 層相當；若碳氫方案單價較低，兩者差距將縮小。
4. 悲觀：在基本情境之外，Kyber 正交背板 CCL 價值取交換器板之 4 倍（3～5 倍之中值）、PTFE 層占一半，台系龍頭原
   可取得之八成 PTFE 層份額全數流失（價值之 1.6 倍，154～257 億元）；合計較樂觀情境減少 183～321 億元。
5. 淨利換算：營收變動以稅後邊際利益率約 27.1% 換算淨利（2026 年第二季實際毛利率 33.9% ×（1－稅率 20%），營
   業費用視為固定）。
6. 調價：成本轉嫁時，售價與成本同步上升 1%，毛利增加約為營收之 0.339%，稅後約為共識淨利之 +1.1%；供給吃緊
   下主動調價時，成本不變，售價上升 1% 幾近全數轉為獲利，稅後約 +3.2%。乘以 10 個百分點。
7. 台虹：PTFE 層價值約 64 億元（取 4 億美元中值之一半）× 兩成 ≈ 13 億元。台虹無市場共識預估，以近 12 個月
   （2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 9 月）實際營收 103.5 億元為基準，約 12.4%。
8. 其餘第二供應：樂觀情境下台光電以外之供應商合計約 19～32 億元；若全數由台燿取得，約其 2027 年共識營收 1,049

    台光電：2026 年第一、二季毛利率由 29.4% 升至 33.9%，獲利成長主要來自產品等級升級與報價調整；市場共識預估
   2027 年營收約 3,373 億元、年增約七成。PTFE 僅影響最高階之局部市場，對整體影響有限。
   台燿：第一、二季毛利率由 25.2% 升至 29.7%。依 2026 年第二季法說資料，高速材料（ELL／SLL 與 VLL／LL）合計
   占銅箔基板營收約七成。產業訪談顯示，其前三大客戶為 Google、Amazon 與 SpaceX，伺服器占營收約七成，2026
   年產能滿載、2027 年擴產逾五成，並同步開發 PTFE／M9 混壓材料。泰國子公司新廠興建中，並於 2026 年 10 月辦理
   第六次無擔保轉換公司債。市場共識預估 2027 年營收約 1,049 億元。對台燿而言，ASIC 滲透與產能擴充之重要性高於
   NVL576 材料路線之爭。
   聯茂：第一、二季毛利率由 11.4% 升至 22.0%；主要動能為中低階產品報價調整與高階產能擴充，與樹脂路線之爭關
   聯度最低。
   南亞：同時具備玻纖布、銅箔與 CCL 產能，兼具 PTFE 經驗與自研碳氫配方，為少數可同時參與兩條路線之業者。

 11 風險
   PTFE 滲透速度高於預期：若良率提升迅速、高溫壓合設備到位，正交背板將導入 PTFE 混壓（悲觀情境）；若進一步出
   現全 PTFE 或無布 PTFE 背板，影響將超過本報告之悲觀情境。
   無布化設計普及：無布 CCL 直接減少玻纖布用量，為玻纖布廠之長期風險；剛性與鑽孔問題目前尚未解決。
   價格循環反轉：CCL 本波獲利主要來自報價調整與供給吃緊；各廠積極擴產，若需求成長不及產能擴充，價格效應之反
   轉速度將快於 PTFE 之影響。
   CPO 提前導入：若光通訊較預期提早規模化，交換器板規格可能下修。
   輝達產品時程與架構變動：Rubin Ultra 若遞延，PTFE 相關營收亦將順延；NVL576 若僅小量出貨，基本情境之 PTFE
   需求與台系廠影響均將低於本報告推算；Kyber 機櫃之設計若再調整，正交背板之材料選擇亦可能改變。
   共識預估變動：本報告以 2026 年 10 月 14 日之市場共識為分母；共識上修將使各情境之影響比例下降，反之亦然。
   本報告之假設：NVL576 CCL 價值 3～5 億美元、台系龍頭份額八成、第二供應兩成、正交背板價值為交換器板 3～5
   倍、碳氫替代方案單價與 PTFE 層相當；任一假設變動均影響數字，惟不改變「PTFE 影響小於價格調整」之結論。

崇越　5434 TT　（電子－電子通路）

先進製程擴張為營運成長基礎

投資與評價

1. 光阻劑、矽晶圓、光罩等半導體核心材料需求持續強勁，另環保工程業務受惠於大型專案認列，2Q26 營收優於我們先前預期。
2. 綜觀 7~9 月營收皆持續高檔，研究部推估主要受惠於晶圓代工業產能持續擴張，且另有漲價挹注營收表現，3Q26 營收為 236.7 億元。
3. 半導體主力產品及新品需求皆見成長，帶動半導體材料業務持續維持持續增，研究部上調 FY26 光阻劑營收全年增幅達 30%以上。
4. 研究部上調 FY26/FY27 營收獲利預估，預估 FY26/FY27 EPS 分別為 30.72/32.34 元，研究部維持買進投資建議，目標價調升至 700 元，以 21x FY27 獲利預估。

重點更新

半導體材料業務仍為今年年度成長主旋律

半導體主力產品及新品需求皆見成長，帶動半導體材料業務持續維持持續增，研究部上調 FY26 光阻劑營收全年增幅達 30%以上。矽晶圓市場需求情況逐漸轉好，藍寶石基板、散熱材料等新品亦開始於 1H26 成長力道逐漸顯著，使其他電子材料 1H26 年增率達 30%以上。研究部預期產品調漲效應將延續至 4Q26，帶動公司 FY26 整體營運逐季走高，FY27 營運表現亦將優於 FY26。

工程業務 2H26 進入工程傳統認列旺季

大型案件有所斬獲，環保工程在手訂單約近 200 億水平，隨下半年進入工程傳統認列旺季，研究部預期營收將逐季走高，預估 FY26 全年工程業務營收將年增 20%以上。崇越持續進行海外布局，目前東南亞案件持續進行中，亦添新美國以製程工程拓展，今年陸續於多國設立據點，奠定工程業務及半導體材料業務海外發展基礎。

先進製程擴張為營運成長基礎

信越於先進製程穩固的市佔率奠定崇越營運成長基礎。受惠先進製程產能持續釋出且 UTR 維持高檔，加上成熟製程於 2H26 復甦趨勢確立，晶圓代工產業動能明確。在此背景下，崇越憑藉於光阻劑與晶圓的穩固市占，並積極布局先進封裝材料，奠定產業鏈地位。此外，工程業務營收則持續改善，疊加在手訂單持續維持高水準，挹注營運動能。考量半導體材料業務動能提升，研究部上調 FY26/FY27 營收獲利預估。

Key Takeaways
   Connectivity has become the bottleneck, and NPO is a potential solution. We
   observed growing discussion and interest in NPO at the conference.

On Day 2 of the 2026 OCP Global Summit, an IPEC optical interconnect workshop
focused on discussions around NPO. Industry participants such as Source Photonics,
Lightcounting, Alibaba, Meta, Oracle, Microsoft, Ciena, Ligent, Genuine Optics,
Lumentum, Lumilens, NVIDIA and Huawei presented their views on NPO.

The industry has formed the view connectivity, rather than compute alone, is
becoming the primary bottleneck. Near-packaged optics (NPO) move optical
conversion closer to compute, targeting better signal integrity, bandwidth, and
energy efficiency. OpenCPX explicitly targets common mechanical, electrical,
optical, thermal, and management interfaces across suppliers, providing the
ecosystem with a shared implementation framework rather than only a broad
architectural vision.

However, we also observed debate over whether pluggable NPO offers materially
better flexibility and serviceability than CPO. Key concern on CPO is that optical
failure could result in scrapping an entire ASIC assembly.

Overall, we observed growing discussion and interests in NPO, implying a greater
likelihood of accelerated commercialization over the next 12-18 months, in our view.

CY27 pricing should accelerate, amid tighter supply-demand in CY27-28, but

25%+ in CY27, below buy-side expectations of ~50%. Our supply/demand outlook
points to undersupply next year, with larger substrates, higher layer counts, and
greater manufacturing complexity further constraining usable output. Raw material
cost pass-through was a key driver of CY26 price increases, we expect supply
tightness to play a greater role in CY27. This should allow pricing to outpace cost
inflation, driving faster margin expansion. We remain constructive on pricing, but the
magnitude and timing of increases depends on customer-level negotiations.

capacity growth: As supply tightens, the ability to deliver incremental volume
